mentions.name: go-mfp
mentions.description: An in-development OpenPrinting tool that emulates the behavior of modern driverless printers so printing support can be worked on and tested without physical hardware; still under heavy development and not ready, with no equivalent existing for older printers and scanners that require their own drivers.
mentions.problem: Testing printer and scanner support generally requires physical devices; emulation for modern driverless printers is not ready yet, and nothing exists for older driver-dependent models.
mentions.source_excerpt: There's ongoing work on modern (driverless) printer behavior emulation, but it is under heavy development and not ready yet: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/go-mfp

evidence.value: There's ongoing work on modern (driverless) printer behavior emulation, but it is under heavy development and not ready yet: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/go-mfp
